steps: Pin and validate the release commit/artifact hash.
Create source archive, tracked path/hash manifest and deployment/migration metadata without credentials.
Parent obtains a consistent D1 export into a private ephemeral staging directory.

Package source + export + metadata; encrypt client-side with an audited tool such as age using an operator-provided public recipient. Never put the private key in Git, scripts, chat or the backup bucket.
Upload ciphertext plus ciphertext checksum to independent storage with retention/versioning or immutability and a separate account/failure domain. Verify size/hash/readback.
Retain recovery keys separately with an offline second custodian; test decrypt/recovery on isolated infrastructure.
Only expire old ciphertext after a verified new copy and retention policy. Keep operational logs free of rows/tokens.

default_targets_not_guarantees.D1: An hourly snapshot is an initial option only; at most 1h RPO if each job succeeds, not zero loss.
default_targets_not_guarantees.retention: Example 24 hourly + 30 daily; owner to approve costs/legal retention later.
default_targets_not_guarantees.RTO: Unknown until a full restore + authentication/access drill is measured.

recovery_runbook: Choose a verified backup ID and capture an incident timestamp. Do not overwrite the primary or silently change private audience.
Verify ciphertext checksum and decrypt with the offline recovery identity in a private ephemeral environment. Never print raw SQL or keys.
Verify every manifest hash, original source commit, schema version and D1 snapshot provenance. Check completeness of tables and indexes.

Reconstruct the source index if using a plain tar: git init, then add exactly the recorded tracked paths in the isolated directory. Rebuild Worker with Node and run scripts/validate-worker.mjs; do not redeploy to the original Site inadvertently.

Restore SQL into a fresh isolated SQLite/D1-compatible database. Run integrity/schema/constraint checks, aggregate counts and fixture queries without logging rows. Validate source=demo, uniqueness and owner scoping.

Attach DB binding and configure a trusted auth gateway/audience before exposing the recovered API. With no gateway, keep it private/offline or fail closed; never trust a public caller identity header.
Test anonymous denied access, authorized user A vs user B isolation, stable identity mapping and unchanged private audience. Confirm no real payments are claimed.
Test app/static/PWA behavior and media manifests; browser-only drafts/photos require their own archive and cannot be inferred from D1.

Only after approved independent domain/traffic control exists, fence the old writer, promote the selected single writer, switch traffic and measure session/data continuity. Otherwise perform a controlled manual recovery in supported Sites hosting.
Record actual RPO/RTO, discrepancies, restore hashes and failback steps. Do not declare instant HA or a successful drill from a code build alone.
local_now_without_resources: Keep this runbook and a pinned source/artifact manifest proposal.
Inspect source/migrations/archive inventory without live data.
After PERFREADY2, verify the exact release source tree and hashes locally.
Optionally perform a schema-only/synthetic SQLite restore in /tmp; it proves only schema portability, not real data/auth/cloud recovery.
remaining_information_for_later: Approved independent backup storage/region/account and retention budget
Encryption public recipient and separate key custody
User-owned domain plus DNS/traffic management rights

Production export mechanism and snapshot-consistency guarantees
